description: Advocate for your needs every single time 🫶 #advocateforyourself #criticalthinking #fyp #advocacy
transcript: It is so important to advocate for yourself. When it comes to advocacy for myself, it's always important that I lead with logic. When we lead with emotions, our vision gets muddled. When it comes to advocating for myself, I am always willing to sit in uncomfortable conversations. I am always willing to throw myself into discomfort in order to get what I need. That is what having both hands on the wheel looks like. That is what having full autonomy of your life looks like. You have to advocate for yourself.
